elements.problem: Header context 'postnatal patient (within 6 weeks of delivery)' is encoded with the time comparison reversed. Per will-briefing 'Time-based criteria', (>= (onset X) (time_ago N)) means onset at least N ago and (< (onset X) (time_ago N)) means within N. The rules use (<= (onset Postpartum state) (time_ago 6 weeks)), which means postpartum onset AT LEAST 6 weeks ago, so the Urgent rule and the PPH rule fire only outside the 6-week window and never inside it. Should be (< ... (time_ago 6 weeks)) or (>= (time_ago ...)) form. The 'Postpartum state' presenting complaint itself (86569001) is a reasonable choice.

rule_level_problems.rule: Urgent: routine postnatal care with danger signs; Diagnose probable postpartum haemorrhage at routine postnatal care
rule_level_problems.problem: All three onset comparisons use (<= (onset Postpartum state) (time_ago N)), which per the briefing convention means 'at least N ago'. The 6-week window and the 1-week seizure window are inverted: the Urgent rule and PPH rule cannot fire for a patient within 6 weeks of delivery. Also note onset of 'Postpartum state' is captured when the finding is recorded, not at delivery, so even the corrected window approximates time since delivery poorly.
Footnote 1 defines 'shock likely'; no probable rule exists and the Urgent rule uses (clinical_finding Shock) instead of (active_condition Shock). Confusion/restlessness and weakness are not checked.
'Recent seizure up to 1 week postpartum, treat as eclampsia' arguably warrants a possible/probable Eclampsia diagnosis rule; none exists (borderline - 'treat as' is a management directive).

rule_level_problems.rule: Check for urgent routine postnatal care conditions
rule_level_problems.problem: check_for omits a 'Recent' qualifier for seizure and any qualifier for 'soaks pad in < 5 minutes'; Hb < 6 correctly omitted. Pallor concept 'Pallor of skin of face' is narrower than the page's 'Pallor'.

summary: The postpartum time windows are inverted: (<= (onset Postpartum state) (time_ago 6 weeks)) means onset at least 6 weeks ago, so the Urgent rule and the probable PPH rule never fire within 6 weeks of delivery, and the seizure branch requires >= 1 week postpartum instead of <= 1 week. Otherwise the red-box criteria are mapped faithfully (OR structure, thresholds, PPH as active_condition), but footnote 1's 'shock likely' has no probable Shock rule and the outside-box same-day referral criteria (BP >= 140/90 within 1 week, abdominal pain/discharge, infected wounds) are not encoded.
